Post this I was asked how do I use AI and a question related to my work experience, asking about a deep dive I've done for debugging an issue.

In-person round, Standard Intro, following this I was asked how to handle hallucinations in a large codebase by AI models, a DSA question about how to deploy dependent services (topological sort). Post this I was asked to tell how can we deploy cyclic dependency services (if they absolutely need to exist).
